patch.role: Adds a background-colour close tag instead of a colour close tag.
lines: if '[color' in start and '[/color]' not in end:

inputs.nc_other_colour: colour-only style with a different colour

rationale: A prepends [/color] to the closing tag of a colour-only style. The candidate patch prepends [/bgcolor] when a colour start tag is present and no colour close tag exists: with A present the guard is false, but with A removed the emitted BBCode differs from A's. Neither the patch nor its absence reproduces A, so no masking relation exists.
